name: Log new YouTube videos to Google Sheets and alert via Telegram

parameters.content:
## Log new YouTube videos to Google Sheets and alert via Telegram

### How it works

Runs every hour (or manually), searches YouTube for each configured query through the RecentReborn API, and follows up to two result pages per query. Every video is checked against the IDs already in your Google Sheet, so the sheet itself is the deduplication memory: it works on manual test runs, survives re-imports, and can be reset by deleting rows.

New videos are filtered (max age, excluded keywords, blocked channels, optional strict title match), merged when several queries find the same video, and appended as rows with a thumbnail preview and a *Status* column for team triage.

Telegram gets one instant message per video from a **watchlist** channel, one compact digest for everything else, and one combined warning if any search failed. Manual runs with nothing new send a short health report.

### Setup steps

1. Create a Google Sheet with a tab named `Videos` and this header row:
`Video ID | Title | Channel | Channel ID | Format | Published At | First Seen At | Matched Queries | Video URL | Channel URL | Thumbnail | Watchlist | Status`
2. Add your RecentReborn API key as an **HTTP Header Auth** credential (Name: `Authorization`, Value: `Bearer YOUR_KEY`) on *Search YouTube*.
3. Connect Google Sheets credentials on both Sheets nodes and Telegram credentials on both Telegram nodes.
4. Fill in *Set Monitor Config*: queries (one per line), sheet URL, Telegram chat ID, filters.
5. Run manually once, then activate the schedule.

### Requirements

- A RecentReborn API account (app.recentreborn.com) with an API key
- A Google account and a Telegram bot

### Customization

Each run uses `queries × formats × up to 2 pages` API calls (3 queries, one format, hourly ≈ 144 calls/day at most). Change the page limit in *Search YouTube* → Pagination, and the interval in the schedule trigger.

## Load config and known videos

Triggers, central configuration, the list of video IDs already logged in the sheet, and one search job per query/format.

## Search YouTube per query

Loops through the jobs one by one. Each search follows up to 2 pages. Failures and malformed responses become marker items so the loop always finishes and errors are reported together.

## Deduplicate and log to Sheets

Drops known and filtered videos, merges duplicates across queries, and appends only new rows. If the sheet write fails, alerts are held back and the videos are retried next run.

## Telegram alerts

Instant alerts for watchlist channels, a chunked digest for the rest, a combined error warning, and a health report on manual runs.
